channel.title: N-able — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by N-able (n-able).

item.title: CVE-2026-125880 · 8.3 HIGH — Stored XSS via MMS3 patch metadata (admin context)
item.description: Improper neutralization of HTTP headers for scripting syntax vulnerability in N-able N-central allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects N-central: before 26.4.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-125882 · 8.6 HIGH — RCE via file repository upload path traversal
item.description: Relative path traversal vulnerability in N-able N-central allows Path Traversal. This issue affects N-central: before 26.4.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-125881 · 9.3 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Schema-hint SSRF via service import schema validation
item.description: Server-Side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in N-able N-central allows Server Side Request Forgery. This issue affects N-central: before 26.4.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-125879 · 8.6 HIGH — Local privilege escalation to root via nable-writable syslog-ng config
item.description: Incorrect privilege assignment vulnerability in N-able N-central allows Privilege Escalation. This issue affects N-central: before 26.4.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-125878 · 8.7 HIGH — Multiple OGNL Injection vulnerabilities
item.description: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') vulnerability in N-able N-central allows Resource Injection. This issue affects N-central: before 26.4.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-125958 · 7.5 HIGH — Root RCE via unsigned NSP upgrade package upload
item.description: Download of code without integrity check vulnerability in N-able N-central allows Remote Code Inclusion. This issue affects N-central: through 24.6.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-91000 · 8.4 HIGH — Insecure IPC Channels lead to local privilege escalation
item.description: Missing authentication for critical function vulnerability in N-able N-central allows Privilege Escalation. This issue affects N-central: before 2026.4.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-125883 · 9.3 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Multiple XXE Vulnerabilities
item.description: Improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability in N-able N-central allows XML Schema Poisoning. This issue affects N-central: before 26.4.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-86218 · 10 CRITICAL 💥 🌩️ — pre-authentication remote code execution
item.description: N-central is vulnerable to a pre-auth remote code execution This issue affects N-central: before 2026.3.1.14.

item.title: CVE-2026-86206 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Access control filter bypass allows unauthorised access to APIs
item.description: A vulnerability in the N-central internal API access control filter allows unauthorised access to internal APIs. This is fixed in N-central 2026.3 HF3 and 2026.4

item.title: CVE-2026-86207 · 7.7 HIGH — Authentication bypass leads to unauthorised access to N-central
item.description: An authentication bypass in N-central < 2026.3 HF 3 leads to authentication bypass in internal only APIs

item.title: CVE-2026-15580 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — PassPortal browser extension: vault token disclosure via unvalidated postMessage
item.description: vault token disclosure via unvalidated postMessage vulnerability in N-able PassPortal allows Authentication Abuse. This issue affects the PassPortal browser extension: before 3.49.6.

item.title: CVE-2026-18577 · 8.2 HIGH 💥 🌩️ — Incomplete patch leads to administrative account takeover
item.description: An incomplete patch for CVE-2026-18556 allows for authentication bypass and account takeover in N-central Versions through 2026.3.1

item.title: CVE-2026-18556 · 8.2 HIGH 💥 🌩️ — Unauthenticated administrative account takeover
item.description: Authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in N-able N-central allows Authentication Bypass. This issue affects N-central: through 2026.1.

item.title: CVE-2025-11367 · 10 CRITICAL 🌩️ — N-central windows software probe Remote Code Execution
item.description: The N-central Software Probe < 2025.4 is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via deserialization

item.title: CVE-2025-11366 · 9.4 CRITICAL — N-central Authentication bypass via path traversal
item.description: N-central < 2025.4 is vulnerable to authentication bypass via path traversal

item.title: CVE-2025-11700 · 8.4 HIGH — N-central Multiple XXE Injection Vulnerabilities
item.description: N-central versions < 2025.4 are vulnerable to multiple XML External Entities injection leading to information disclosure

item.title: CVE-2025-9316 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — N-central unauthenticated sessionID generation
item.description: N-central < 2025.4 can generate sessionIDs for unauthenticated users This issue affects N-central: before 2025.4.

item.title: CVE-2025-10231 · 7 HIGH — N-central Incorrect Default Permissions could lead to Privilege Escalation
item.description: An Incorrect File Handling Permission bug exists on the N-central Windows Agent and Probe that, in the right circumstances, can allow a local low-level user to run commands with elevated permissions.

item.title: CVE-2025-7051 · 8.3 HIGH — N-central Syslog Configuration Insecure Direct Object Reference
item.description: On N-central, it is possible for any authenticated user to read, write and modify syslog configuration across customers on an N-central server. This vulnerability is present in all deployments of N-central prior to 2025.2.

item.title: CVE-2025-8875 · 9.4 CRITICAL 💥 — Insecure Deserialization Vulnerability
item.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in N-able N-central allows Local Execution of Code.This issue affects N-central: before 2025.3.1.

item.title: CVE-2025-8876 · 9.4 CRITICAL 💥 — Command Injection Vulnerability
item.description: Improper Input Validation vulnerability in N-able N-central allows OS Command Injection.This issue affects N-central: before 2025.3.1.

item.title: CVE-2024-8510 · 5.3 MEDIUM 🌩️ — N-central Path Traversal
item.description: N-central is vulnerable to a path traversal that allows unintended access to the Apache Tomcat WEB-INF directory. Customer data is not exposed. This vulnerability is present in all deployments of N-central prior to N-central 2024.6.

item.title: CVE-2024-5445 · 3.8 LOW — Ecosystem Agent Insufficient Transport Layer Security
item.description: Ecosystem Agent version 4 < 4.1.5.2597 and Ecosystem Agent version 5 < 5.1.4.2473 did not properly validate SSL/TLS certificates, which could allow a malicious actor to perform a Man-in-the-Middle and intercept traffic between the agent and N-able se…

item.title: CVE-2024-28200 · 9.1 CRITICAL 🌩️ — N-central Authentication Bypass
item.description: The N-central server is vulnerable to an authentication bypass of the user interface. This vulnerability is present in all deployments of N-central prior to 2024.2. This vulnerability was discovered through internal N-central source code review and N…

item.title: CVE-2024-5322 · 9.1 CRITICAL 🌩️ — N-central Authentication Bypass via Session Rebinding
item.description: The N-central server is vulnerable to session rebinding of already authenticated users when using Entra SSO, which can lead to authentication bypass. This vulnerability is present in all Entra-supported deployments of N-central prior to 2024.3.
